findings.body: The commit only claims to plant a custom `chunks` implementation, but hand-rolling it also drops a behaviour that `itertools.batched` guaranteed: `batched` raises `ValueError` when `n < 1`, whereas this loop appends the item before comparing, so `len(current)` is never 0 and the `== size` test can never fire for `size <= 0`. Callers that previously got a loud error now silently receive a single chunk containing every item. If no caller can pass a non-positive size, this is only a latent divergence, but it is an unstated semantic change hidden inside what reads as a like-for-like rewrite.
